title: Error while writing Spark DF to parquet (Parquet column cannot be converted. Column: [word_c], Expected: StringType, Found: INT64
question:
I have a couple of parquet files spread across different folders and I'm using following command to read them into a Spark DF on Databricks:

df = spark.read.option("mergeSchema", "true").schema(parquet_schema).parquet('/mnt/my_blobstorage/snap/*/*.parquet')

My parquet schema contains only StringType. Then I diplay the Dataframe and additionally I do a PrintSchema to make sure that all the columns are of StringType. When I try to write this DF back to my Blob Storage, by using this command:

df.write.parquet('/mnt/my_blobstorage/saved/merged_df.parquet')

It gives me the following error:

Parquet column cannot be converted. Column: [word_c], Expected: StringType, Found: INT64

I have tried all the solutions that I founf on StackOverflow and nothing worked so far. Any ideas?
answer:
I reproduced the above scenario and got same error even though printSchema gave the correct schema.

I agree with @partlov that here the dataframe took the schema from the parquet files and thats the reason for the error.

In this case, you can try the below workaround to resolve the error.

First read the parquet files without giving your schema. After that convert the column type to String using below code. Now, you can write this to your final parquet file.

df3 = spark.read.option("mergeSchema", "true").parquet('/mnt/mountdata/snap/*/*.parquet')
df3.printSchema()

from pyspark.sql.types import *
from pyspark.sql.functions import col
for i in df3.dtypes:
    if i[1]!="string":
        df3=df3.withColumn(i[0],col(i[0]).cast(StringType()))
        print("done for column : ",i[0])
print("dataframe with required schema : ")
df3.printSchema()
display(df3)
